data.title: 椎名真昼 · 邻家客厅沙发的大号针织衫跨坐
data.description: 大号米色粗针织毛衣松松垮垮挂在肩头，真昼跨坐在你的腰间。平日里端庄完美的天使大人此刻耳根通红，双手按在你的胸前微微起伏——「周总是笨拙得让人放不下心……既然不肯主动的话……就由我来……啊嗯、不准一直盯着我看……」
data.action: 跨坐腰间针织衫半褪露肩，金发垂落胸口起伏，琥珀瞳娇羞微嗔
data.lighting: 柔和暖光与唯美阴影交错
data.promptProse: Viewed from a low first-person perspective on a cozy apartment sofa bathed in warm night lamplight, Mahiru sits astride her partner with both palms pressed onto his chest and looks down with flushed ears and gentle embarrassment.
data.nsfwProse: Her oversized oatmeal cable-knit sweater hangs loosely off her shoulder with one breast slipping bare as she moves gently in a cowgirl position.
data.animaCaption: Straddling her partner's lap on the warm lamp-lit apartment sofa with both palms braced against his chest, she leans down with crimson-flushed ears and shy embarrassment as her chunky cream knit sweater slips off one shoulder to bare her chest.
